title: Relay board lane and step lines drop cells from the right, whole
findings_note: s356 relay 2026-10-18: lane headers and step lines (`_fit`, tui.py) still skip a cell that does not fit and keep later ones, against docs/tui.md's "drops cells from the right, whole"
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the ended line (s356), colors, or the queue pane.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: s356 gave `_place` an `ordered` flag and used it for the ended line only. Lane headers and step lines still go through `_fit` without it, so a narrow board can show a later, shorter cell beside a dropped earlier one. docs/tui.md states the drop-from-the-right rule for every board line.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/tui.py` (`_fit` callers for lane headers and step lines): pass `ordered=True`, or scope the docs sentence to the ended line if a line wants the old rule.
- `tests/test_tui.py`; `docs/tui.md` if the rule is scoped; `CHANGELOG.md` under Fixed.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests; watch them go red.
2. Pass `ordered=True` at each caller the docs cover; keep wide layouts unchanged.
3. CHANGELOG; mutation-check.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
